evidence.note: The Tauri sidecar_transport command is the only ipc=true producer and always serializes rpc_session_token as a required string.
browserSidecarTransport is the other producer and only writes ipc=false with an optional dev token; ipc=true && token=none is not a supported write.

disqualifier.note: Leftover beside seeded HeroClipLayer.playback. The element writer clears playing when element is null, but the playing writer spreads state and sets playing without an element guard, so playing-true with a null element remains a supported write.
Leftover beside seeded ThreadLoadState. turnActive is the global turn fiber; streaming is this thread's optimistic turn Option. Some+false is the explicit Reply-completed waiting-for-refresh path.

Leftover beside seeded syncing/busy and connected/busy. connected is the Box probe on a successful status result; syncing is the panel command machine. The trigger ANDs them as a permission guard, and mixed true/false is legal.
std::fs::OpenOptions builder flags at the WebKit extension install boundary; create_new and write are independent OpenOptions contract bits, and mixed create/truncate versus write-only is legal.

Leftover beside seeded empty/failed/loading. empty AND-folds O.isNone(streaming) with empty turns, empty unreconciled, and timeline success. AND of independent observations is not a masked empty-versus-streaming union; ready-with-turns and streaming-with-turns remain legal.
